Answer ID: 8752 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2168/1694=H/1429) Deliver the rewards (of financial and physical good deeds) to your late grandfather as much as you can, you shall have its benefit and reward in the world hereafter, in-sha-Allah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
